reason: The only offered combination adds mineral to the living frameworks, matching the goal of reinforcing them.
expectation: I expect it to produce reinforced bone frameworks, though I don't know their exact name.

effect: The mineral reinforced the living collagen framework, and the new goal is to stabilize the joint and attach the muscles.
reaction: The explanation that bone remains living tissue was useful.
reason: Cartilage is shaped to cover the facing bone ends, so adding it seems like a practical step toward the joint.
expectation: I expect the cartilage to cover the elbow surfaces, though other parts will still be needed to stabilize the joint.

effect: The cartilage now caps the facing bone ends and appears to spread compression across the contact area.
reaction: The picture makes the cushioning role clear.
reason: Joint fluid is the only offered combination, and its picture shows it between joint surfaces.
expectation: I expect the fluid to form a layer between the cushioned bone ends, helping them move against each other.

effect: The fluid forms a film between the cartilage surfaces, and I learned it also helps nourish cartilage.
reaction: The nourishment role was a useful surprise.
reason: Ligaments connect neighboring bones, so the only offered combination should help stabilize the elbow.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to join the bones and stabilize the joint while allowing it to bend.

effect: The ligaments hold the joint together, and the framework now has slots for the opposing muscle pulls.
reaction: The marked attachment points make the next step clear.
reason: I’ll attach the bending muscles to begin filling the two pull slots.
expectation: I expect the bending muscles to fill the front pull slot; the straightening muscles will still need to be attached.

alternatives.reason: The straightening muscles also fit the goal, but I chose to attach the front muscles first.

effect: The bending muscles are attached, and their pull bends the elbow. The straightening muscles still need to be fitted.
reaction: The pull arrow makes the attachment's purpose clear.
reason: The straightening muscles are the only offered combination and fill the remaining opposing pull slot.
expectation: I expect the straightening muscles to attach to the rear pull slot, completing the opposing muscle attachments.

effect: The straightening muscles complete the arm, and the explanation clarifies why opposing pulls are needed to move the forearm in both directions.
reaction: The contrast between bending and straightening made the completed construction satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the straightening muscles was most worthwhile because the final explanation connected both muscle groups to movement in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding cartilage was clear but less engaging on its own; it was an expected step with only one combination offered.

surprise.text: I was surprised that joint fluid also helps nourish cartilage, which has no blood vessels of its own.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the item pictures and goals gave each combination a clear purpose, although most steps offered only one gameplay choice.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the completed arm is used, though I hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly single-option sequence here.
